titulo: Dabbing the drop before it sets
caption:
Dabbing the drop before it sets

"It'll dry. Who'll see?" "Dab it now." The drop was gone before it set.

A fresh drop comes out in a minute, and the same drop a week later stays for good.

For whoever dabs the stain while it is still fresh.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A bedroom with a big tan coat standing open on the right with a dark brown drop on its front and a pale blue cloth on the floor beside it. A plum block figure with narrowed eyes in the middle says it'll dry. who'll see? A ink-black block figure with white eyes at the left answers dab it now, and the cloth hops up and dabs the drop twice until it fades away. The plum one's eyes go wide and says ...it's gone. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me, dabbing it now.
